exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-29T12:00:00Z
mkdir source destination empty-destination

exec card --store $WORK/source init --no-config --prefix src- --board-name Source

exec touch $WORK/empty-destination/board.sqlite3
! exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source board copy --to-store $WORK/empty-destination
stderr 'not an existing Cardamom store'
! exists empty-destination/board.sqlite3-wal
! exists empty-destination/board.sqlite3-shm
exec sh -c 'test ! -s "$1"' check-empty $WORK/empty-destination/board.sqlite3

exec card --store $WORK/destination init --no-config --prefix src- --board-name Existing

exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source config set --scope board issue.id.strategy sequential
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source create --key external-1 'Copied issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/source-issue.txt

# A live claim prevents the source snapshot from being accepted.
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source claim src-1
! exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source board copy --to-store $WORK/destination
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/active-claim.txt
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source release src-1 --waiting 'root acceptance'
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source state set src-1 'State for %src-1.' --next 'Continue %src-1.'
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source log post src-1 'Log for %src-1.'
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source result set src-1 'Result for %src-1.'

# The destination's store-wide issue collision is remapped with copied policy.
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Existing config set --scope board issue.id.strategy sequential
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Existing create 'Existing issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/existing-issue.txt

# Same-store aliases and existing destination names are rejected.
! exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source board copy --to-store $WORK/source
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/same-store.txt
! exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source board copy --to-store $WORK/destination --name Existing
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/name-collision.txt

exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source board copy --to-store $WORK/destination
stdout 'copied board "Source" as board_[0-9a-f]+ in project project_00000000000000000000: 1 issue, 1 Log entry, 0 attachments, 0 blobs'
! stderr .

exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Source show src-2 --context
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/copied-show.txt
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Source --json state show src-2
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/copied-state.json
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Source log show src-2
stdout 'Log for %src-2\.'
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Source search 'Result for'
stdout '^1 match$'
stdout 'src-2 +waiting +result'

# Every portable value is an explicit board override in the destination.
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Source config show --scope board
stdout 'issue.id.prefix +src- +board'
stdout 'issue.id.strategy +sequential +board'
stdout 'issue.summary.max_bytes +2048 +board'
stdout 'attachment.max_bytes +104857600 +board'

# An identical retry returns the durable receipt without another board.
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source board copy --to-store $WORK/destination
stdout 'previously copied board "Source"'
exec card --store $WORK/destination board list
stdout 'Existing'
stdout 'Source'

# Changed publications remain a policy error rather than a schema constraint.
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source board edit --description Changed
! exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source board copy --to-store $WORK/destination
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/changed-snapshot.txt

-- golden/source-issue.txt --
src-1
-- golden/active-claim.txt --
error: source board has active claims
-- golden/existing-issue.txt --
src-1
-- golden/same-store.txt --
error: source and destination stores are the same physical store
-- golden/name-collision.txt --
error: destination board name "Existing" already exists; use --name
-- golden/copied-show.txt --
ID: src-2
Title: Copied issue
Type: task
Status: waiting
Priority: 2
Assignee: -
Parent: -
Keys: external-1
Labels: -
Depends on: -
Blocks: -
Log entries: 1
Attachments: -

State:
State for %src-2.

Result:
Result for %src-2.
-- golden/copied-state.json --
{"issue_id":"src-2","body":"State for %src-2.","next_action":"Continue %src-2.","author":"test-user","updated":1785326400}
-- golden/changed-snapshot.txt --
error: source board has changed since its previous copy; incremental synchronization is not supported
